info.title: Diaspora Unlocked API
info.description: Versioned network contract. Web sessions use HttpOnly cookies; native sessions use opaque bearer tokens held in platform-secure storage. Travel offers are research, and order requests do not constitute payment. Client request/response schemas cover authentication, travel, catalogue/orders, search, contact and assistant chat/planning. x-contract-coverage=route-inventory explicitly identifies registered operations whose full provider/admin payload contracts are not yet verified. Backend tests compare registered routes and validate representative HTTP responses; external provider delivery and native device execution are separate checks.

post.description: Cookie-backed writes require an Origin or Referer matching the server CORS allowlist. When CSRF enforcement is enabled (the production default), also send a nonempty X-CSRF-Token header. Opaque native Bearer session requests do not use the cookie CSRF branch; an explicit Authorization header never falls back to a cookie.

parameters.description: Cookie-backed writes require an allowed Origin, or an allowed Referer if Origin is absent.

post.description: Compatibility payment endpoint for dummy_gateway orders in non-production environments. Production returns 403. Send the order token in X-Order-Access-Token, or legacy manageToken in the JSON body; query credentials are ignored on POST.
